scope: Law of Root October 13, 2025; common rules, four base factions, Fall/Winter, base Vagabond characters, dominance and coalitions; exclude expansion content, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.

questions.question: How is rule determined, including ordinary ties, Eyrie ties, tokens and the Vagabond pawn?
What makes a normal move legal, can the same warriors move repeatedly, and do rivers count as paths?
Describe battle from ambush through removal: foiling, early ending, dice limits, extra hits, removal priorities and who scores removed buildings/tokens.
How do crafting costs, repeat use of crafting pieces, absent supply items and duplicate persistent effects work?
When and at what VP can you activate dominance, what wins each suit, and can an activated card be replaced or discarded?
What happens to a dominance card spent for suit, and how can another player take it, especially a bird dominance card?
For standard two-player setup, what deck change, hand size, ruins/item setup and faction setup order apply?
What does the Keep forbid or permit, how do Field Hospitals work, and can the Keep be rebuilt?
State Marquise Daylight order, action allowance, March moves, Recruit limit and Overwork cost.
How does the Marquise build, including rule, wood network, track selection and scoring?
State Eyrie Birdsong steps and the no-roost recovery placement requirement.
How does the Eyrie resolve its Decree, including action suit locations, within-column order and Build restrictions?
What exactly happens in Turmoil, including Viziers, leaders, pieces on map and the rest of the turn?
When does Outrage trigger, what is paid, and what if the player has no matching card or the supporter stack is full?
How do Alliance Revolt and Spread Sympathy differ in timing/order, eligible clearing, supporter cost, martial law and results?
How does Alliance train officers and organize, and what does losing a base do to supporters/officers?
How do Vagabond refresh, Slip, normal Move and forest Rest work, including hostile destinations and Evening drawing?
How do Vagabond Explore, Quest and Repair work, including costs, rewards and item sides?
When does a faction become Hostile to Vagabond, when is Infamy scored, can Aid undo Hostility, and what does Strike target?
What are coalition eligibility, timing, VP requirement, partner selection and victory, and what changes if partner is Hostile?
Which rules take precedence among cards, Law, Learning to Play and faction rules, and can an ordinary card override a cannot?
Who chooses unclear simultaneous resolutions, and may you interrupt a March between its two moves to take another action or spend a bird?
What do at-start and at-end phase timings mean, and can you take ordinary Daylight actions after beginning the last step of your turn?
What hand/deck/pile information can players inspect or reveal, and may non-binding deals transfer cards or require consent?
What happens immediately when shared deck empties, and how do bird substitutions work for forced non-bird discards versus explicit bird costs?
If instructed to place more pieces than remain, can you use proxies or choose to place fewer than available, and does shortage waive costs or Eyrie obligations?
Where do placed and removed pieces normally come from/go, what happens to removed items, and when do effects of simultaneous removals trigger?
When a player is forced to move or battle, whose restrictions/abilities and battle decisions apply?
Can an enemy replace a piece in the Keep clearing, and how is a swap different from a move or place?
When two players simultaneously reach 30 VP, who wins?
How do forest adjacency and Winter river affect Vagabond Slip, and does Fall add any special map rule?
Give Marquise standard starting placements and supplies, including its unoccupied corner and building-track arrangement.
Give Eyrie standard starting placements, leader/Vizier procedure and remaining roost arrangement.
What does Alliance start with in supply, on its board, in hand/supporters, and on the map?
Describe Vagabond setup other than hidden ruin items: pawn, quests, relationships and marked starting items.
What Reach totals and base-faction values guide choosing two-, three- and four-player mixes?
When and how much wood does Marquise produce, what limits production, and how does its Evening draw work?
If Marquise Recruit has more eligible recruiters than available warriors, what is placed and who chooses where?
How do Eyrie item crafting and its Builder leader interact with printed VP and extra crafting-point effects?
For each Eyrie leader give the Vizier columns and special ability.
If Charismatic must Recruit but only one Eyrie warrior remains in supply, can placing that one fulfill the Decree?
Does Alliance Guerrilla War bypass warrior limits, and how are the dice assigned when Alliance defends?
Can Alliance craft from Supporters, inspect them, or count them toward its five-card hand limit?
Can Alliance first Spread Sympathy into a clearing and then Revolt there in that same Birdsong?
Do two enemy players each having two warriors trigger Martial Law when spreading sympathy, and does Martial Law increase Organize cost?
Does placing warriors in a sympathetic clearing or moving only Vagabond pawn there cause Outrage, and what if allied warriors accompany Vagabond?
What Alliance Evening operations are available, does using an officer consume it, and when are cards drawn?
What happens to Vagabond pawn when a revolt or another enemy remove-all-pieces effect hits its clearing?
What determines Vagabond rolled hits and defenseless status, do exhausted swords count, and how are excess hits handled?
How do tea/coins/bags enter or leave item tracks, what is track capacity, and can damaged face-up items pay actions?
How is Vagabond capacity calculated, what counts toward load, when is it checked and where do excess items go?
Does forest Rest refresh an undamaged exhausted item, and how does it differ from Refresh or Repair?
What is Vagabond Aid cost and target, is a crafted item required, and how are repeated Aid relationship improvements counted?
What changes at Allied status: Aid points, moving warriors and attacking with them, and can you use allied warriors against their own faction?
When Vagabond takes hits using allied warriors, when and under what comparison does that ally become Hostile?
Can Vagabond craft a card requiring fox and rabbit icons from one clearing, reuse the pawn for multiple craftings, and immediately use a crafted item?
List base Vagabond characters with starting items and special action costs/results, including Ranger timing.
After removing a ruin last item, what happens to its building slot, and can ordinary building placement remove a ruin instead?
Can a coalition partner be attacked as an enemy, and does coalition automatically grant Allied relationship powers?
A Vagabond battles a previously non-Hostile faction on its own turn, removes two warriors followed by one building. How much removal/Infamy VP, and why?
What is the cost of a normal Vagabond move into a clearing with only hostile buildings versus one with hostile warriors from several factions?
Does taking an available dominance card activate it immediately, and do taking/activating use a Marquise action?
Can ownership of faction pieces change, and are items faction pieces that belong to the faction holding them?
What happens to immediate-effect versus persistent crafting cards, and can a card in your play area be spent as though in hand?
Can ambush or dominance cards be crafted, and what are their other permitted uses?
In standard setup how are starting player/seating, score markers and dice arranged, and does faction setup order set turn order?
When does the ordinary 30-VP victory take effect: must the player finish the action, phase, or turn first?
What pieces must you have in the clearing to initiate an ordinary battle, whom can you choose as defender, and must you rule that clearing?
Who orders both players' before-roll and after-roll battle effects, and who orders effects triggered by a side's pieces being removed?
In the Count Hits step, how do effects that ignore hits change the total?
When a non-Vagabond base faction crafts an item, where does that item come from and where is it placed, and what is the usual VP reward?
Which crafting pieces do the Eyrie and Alliance activate, how is a crafting piece's suit determined, and what does a three-color question-mark crafting icon require?
How does Alliance Mobilize work, and must Alliance finish all crafting before mobilizing or training during Daylight?
How does the Eyrie score and draw in an ordinary Evening, and does the scoring still happen after Turmoil?
What does the Vagabond pay to initiate its Daylight Battle action, and can an exhausted undamaged sword pay that cost merely because it still counts for rolled hits?
What is the order of phases in a turn, and whose turn begins after Evening ends?
When Vagabond takes a hit, which item must be chosen, where does it go, does its face change, and can already-damaged items absorb another hit?
During Alliance Evening, how many military operations may be taken, and for one Recruit operation how many warriors are placed and where?
How many Daylight actions may the Vagabond take, must the action types follow a fixed order, and may the same action type be repeated?
